loop_primitives.evidence_quote: The generated new TN-SS algorithms are then evaluated in local computers with extensive downstream-task-specific numerical experiments. The experimental results are subsequently used to update the prompts, guiding the LLMs to improve the algorithms in the next iteration.

delegation_mechanism.evidence_quote: the complete prompts used in KC, KR, II and DI are constructed following the same architecture
delegation_mechanism.note: Control passes between phase roles of the same LLM; no separate agent objects.

human_in_loop.evidence_quote: This paper explores the potential of using LLMs to automatically discover improved algorithms without human intervention

long_term_memory.evidence_quote: we first simplify and initialize the clusters with each algorithm in the pool

self_verification.evidence_quote: we construct a sandbox environment to run the code in a relatively isolated setting using small-scale training data before conducting high-cost formal numerical experiments
self_verification.note: Harness runs the generated code and evaluates the objective; scores feed back.

retry_policy.evidence_quote: The experimental results are subsequently used to update the prompts, guiding the LLMs to improve the algorithms in the next iteration.

rollback.evidence_quote: the sandbox will immediately terminate the process and remove the problematic code from the job queue awaiting implementation
rollback.note: Bad code is discarded, but no revert of environment state.
